PRIVACY_TEXT:
This policy explains which personal data {shop} processes when you visit this website or shop here, and which rights you have.

## Who is responsible
The person responsible for this website is named in the legal notice, together with an address and contact details. Write to us there with any question about your data.

## Visiting the website
The website is hosted by Vercel Inc. (USA). When you open a page, the server automatically records technical data such as your IP address, the page, the time and your browser. This is needed to deliver the website and keep it secure (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). The data is deleted after a short time.

## Cookies
We only use cookies the shop needs to work: one keeps you signed in, one remembers your language and one keeps your cart. We don't use analytics, tracking or advertising cookies.

## Customer account and orders
When you create an account or place an order, we store your name, email address, shipping address and your orders. We need them to fulfil the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The database is run by Neon Inc. (USA). Orders are kept as long as tax and commercial law requires (up to 10 years); everything else is deleted when you ask us to.

## Sign in with Google
If you sign in with Google, Google sends us your name, email address and profile picture. We only use them for your account. Google's privacy policy applies: https://policies.google.com/privacy

## Payment
Card payments are processed by Stripe Payments Europe Ltd., PayPal payments by PayPal (Europe) S.à r.l. et Cie, S.C.A. They receive the data needed for the payment (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We never see your full card details.

## Emails
Order confirmations and account emails are sent through Resend (Plus Five Five, Inc., USA), which receives your email address and the content of the email.

## Transfers outside the EU
Some of these providers are based in the USA. These transfers are covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or by the EU standard contractual clauses.

## Your rights
You have the right to access, correct and delete your data, to restrict or object to its processing and to receive it in a portable format. You can also complain to a data protection authority. To use your rights, write to us using the contact details in the legal notice.
